releaseNote:
非常大的更新喵。浏览、做题和草稿的小窝一起升级啦～🐾
导航缩成一团啦喵：Compact Mode 默认开启，设置里可调整，箭头和触控板都能切页；展开不挤按钮，标题栏右侧也看得到更新提醒。
标签放心跳喵：Ctrl + Tab / Ctrl + Shift + Tab 按最近使用顺序切换各多标签页面；浏览标签、分屏、新建标签和可折叠收藏区也收拾好啦。
网页小助手到齐喵：Dark Reader 可随主题切换、识别深色网页和排除站点；AtCoder Better、Codeforces Better 各有设置开关。
爪爪轻划喵：macOS 浏览器支持触控板前进后退，松手确认、回拉取消；网页不可见、组合题目标签刷新缩放、只读网址复制和标签栏留白都修好啦。
草稿有家啦喵：Sketchboard 支持多标签、文件与文件夹、取名及拖拽搬家，停下 1 秒自动保存；右键可清空、导入导出，标签栏能打开代码旁绘图。
题面放大看喵：SPOJ 预览支持 50%–200% 缩放并记住比例；提交遇安全认证才去浏览，结果回来就回到做题。
题目细节顺毛啦喵：「夯 / 普 / 拉」评价、首次 AC 稍后评价、即时点赞；修好重复链接和代码滚动，没有评测工具也能看、复制样例，折叠入口更清楚。
统计跟紧你喵：Dashboard 打开或切回会刷新，源码删除改名后同步记录，空侧栏入口收走啦；Judger 同名文件切换能刷新，侧栏也不抢编辑器焦点。
更新提醒理顺啦喵：清单可选字段异常时跳过，继续读取版本与下载地址，hotfix 修复版也能正确排序。

A big update, meow. Browsing, solving, and sketching all got a cozier nest! 🐾
Curl up the navigation: Compact Mode is on by default and configurable in Settings. Arrows and trackpad gestures switch pages; expanded buttons have room, and Update stays visible on the title bar's right. Purr!
Hop between tabs: Ctrl + Tab / Ctrl + Shift + Tab follow recent-use order across multitab pages. Browser tabs, split views, New Tab, and collapsible favorites got a tidy-up, meow.
Website helpers are on paw: Dark Reader follows themes, detects dark sites, and supports exclusions. AtCoder Better and Codeforces Better have separate switches. Purr!
Swipe gently: macOS browser history supports release to confirm and pull-back to cancel. Fixed invisible pages, paired-tab reload and zoom, copying locked URLs, and tab bar gaps. Meow!
Give sketches a home: multiple tabs, files and folders, naming and drag-and-drop moves, with autosave after one idle second. File menus offer Clear, Import and Export; the tab bar opens drawing beside code. Purr!
Look closer: SPOJ previews remember 50%–200% zoom. Submissions visit Browse for security verification and return to Solve when results arrive. Meow!
Smooth the snags: “夯 / 普 / 拉” ratings, Later after first AC, and instant local likes. Fixed duplicate links and code scrolling; samples stay viewable and copyable without judging tools, with clearer collapse controls. Purr!
Stats keep up: Dashboard refreshes on return and syncs source deletions and renames; its empty sidebar entry is gone. Judger follows same-named file switches, and sidebar updates leave editor focus alone. Meow!
Tidier updates: skip malformed optional manifest fields while still reading version and download details, and put hotfix releases in the right update order. Purr!
